baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun is sourced by two agentive divine qualities through the min construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The n-z-l guest-provision branch makes the object a reception prepared for an arriver; gh-f-r removes the guest's damaging exposure, while r-h-m supplies tender beneficence.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arriving guest supplies the hospitality frame.
Shielding a person from the effect of fault makes pardon part of the reception.
Tenderness expressed as beneficence characterizes the host's treatment of the guest.

changed_reading.before: A reward is given by one who forgives and shows mercy.
changed_reading.after: A pardoned guest is actively received with provision prepared by a tender, protective host.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The n-z-l noun and the min source construction permit attention to movement from giver to recipient.
baseline_models.mechanism: The delivery branch of n-z-l makes the hospitality something made to reach the guest; the preserving cover of gh-f-r and active kindness of r-h-m specify the manner of that delivery.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and conveyance recast the gift as provision arriving from its source.
A preserving cover makes the delivery protective rather than merely distributive.
Beneficent tenderness supplies the delivery's governing disposition.

changed_reading.before: The hospitality is a static banquet already at the destination.
changed_reading.after: The hospitality is also a source-driven benefaction made to arrive protectively at its recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening revelation, the focus hospitality, and the later revelation share a descent noun followed by min and divine qualities. This makes the focus reception the experiential middle member of a surah-wide source signature: what comes from God bears the mode named by the adjoining qualities.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from a source anchors the focus member of the repeated formula.
The opening caused descent supplies the first delivery-from-source formula.
Beneficent tenderness names the opening descent's source mode and matches a focus quality.
The later caused descent supplies the third delivery-from-source formula.
Accurate wisdom specifies one mode carried by the later descent.
Praiseworthiness completes the later formula and highlights the changing quality-pair.

structural_cues: 41:2, 41:32, and 41:42 each use a descent-derived noun followed by min and divine qualities.
The focus formula stands between the surah's two revelation formulas.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three matched constructions; I let their shared syntax transfer a delivery pattern from revelation to hospitality. A live alternative is that the match is only a recurring source formula and does not assimilate the gifts.

changed_reading.before: A benefaction happens to come from the forgiving and merciful one.
changed_reading.after: The hospitality is a personalized divine delivery whose very form, like revelation, carries the qualities of its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Angels descend, replace fear and grief with glad announcement, assume continuing care, and promise what the recipients desire or request. The focus nuzul then reads as a retrospective name for this whole arrival protocol, not only for consumable gifts.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest provision names the completed reception.
The angels' caused descent supplies the incoming movement that initiates reception.
Joy-opening news functions as the guest's welcome announcement.
Taking charge of another's affairs turns welcome into continuing hosted care.
The soul's movement toward what it desires makes provision personally responsive.
Calling or requesting supplies the guest-facing channel through which provision is claimed.

structural_cues: The uninterrupted 41:30-32 sequence moves from angelic descent to reassurance, care, desire, request, and finally nuzul.
The focus is an accusative nominal coda to the promises immediately before it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered acts; I treat the final noun as summing up their function as a reception sequence. It could instead appose only the garden goods promised at the end of 41:31.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a prepared gift waiting for a future guest.
changed_reading.after: The focus names an enacted welcome: escorts arrive, fear is removed, good news is given, care continues, and responsive provision follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents sustenance as deliberately measured for askers, then immediately before the focus promises whatever persons desire and request. The guest provision of n-z-l becomes abundance fitted to recipients rather than an undifferentiated store.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest provision is the focus object whose mode of preparation is being revised.
Deliberate apportioning supplies a model of provision prepared by measure and judgment.
Life-sustaining food gives the material content of calibrated provision.
Asking makes the created sustenance explicitly recipient-facing.
Desire identifies the recipient's inward specification of the hospitality.
Calling or requesting identifies its outward specification.

structural_cues: 41:31 joins inward desire and outward request immediately before the focus guest-provision noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two asker-provision patterns; I connect the distant creation pattern to the immediate promise and infer that nuzul is prepared responsively. The alternative is that 41:10 concerns terrestrial sufficiency without shaping 41:32.

changed_reading.before: Hospitality means lavish but generic abundance.
changed_reading.after: Hospitality is attentively apportioned provision that answers both unspoken desire and spoken request.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts a punitive settled abode and permanent recompense with a person who comes secure. Against that destination field, nuzul expands from a welcome meal into the secure counter-lodging prepared by a forgiving host.

activation_trace.role: Guest provision supplies the positive lodging pole of the contrast.
Settled residence makes the fire a negative lodging against which reception is read.
Action answered by recompense supplies the juridical destination contrast.
Lasting permanence raises the contrast from a temporary stop to an enduring abode.
Coming and arrival supplies the positive entrant's movement toward the destination.
Settled inward security specifies the condition of the positively received arriver.

structural_cues: 41:24 and 41:28 establish punitive residence before the 41:30-32 welcome.
41:40 restates the outcome contrast as being thrown into fire versus coming secure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed residences and arrivals; I let them enlarge the focus's hospitality into destination and dwelling. It remains possible that nuzul names only what is served within the positive destination.

changed_reading.before: Nuzul is refreshment offered after arrival.
changed_reading.after: Nuzul is the secure counter-dwelling itself, a forgiving homecoming opposite the surah's punitive residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human coverings in the surah block access, burden hearing, or attempt concealment, yet fail to protect. The gh-f-r quality reverses that enclosure field: its cover preserves the person from fault's effect without sealing the person away from address, witness, or mercy.

activation_trace.role: A cover that preserves what it covers supplies the positive enclosure.
Shielding from a fault's consequence identifies what the positive enclosure protects against.
A preserving cover becomes obstructive here and supplies the first negative enclosure.
Prevention of access makes the self-declared barrier explicitly relational.
Weight in the ear shows enclosure operating as blocked reception.
Attempted covering fails to prevent bodily witness, exposing false protection.
Repeated weight in the ear confirms the surah-wide pattern of obstructed reception.

structural_cues: 41:5 opens the response to revelation with heart covers, ear weight, and an interpersonal barrier.
41:22 denies successful concealment, while 41:44 repeats ear weight and distance from the call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both preserving and obstructing cover images; I distinguish their direction by outcome, assigning gh-f-r a cover that protects without blocking. The alternative is that these are unrelated cover lexemes with no intended reversal.

changed_reading.before: Ghafur means that liability is canceled before hospitality is given.
changed_reading.after: Ghafur names a permeable protection: exposure to fault is covered while openness to address, witness, and merciful reception is restored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The better response does not mirror harm; it displaces it until an enemy appears as an intimate ally. This supplies an enacted social analogue for the focus pair: pardon absorbs the offense's claim, and mercy moves the relation toward protective nearness.

activation_trace.role: Shielding the offender from the offense's effect supplies the non-retaliatory half of the reversal.
Beneficent tenderness supplies the positive relation produced after harm is not mirrored.
Doing what is good provides the asymmetrical response that powers transformation.
Pushing away the harmful thing supplies the mechanism's active removal rather than passive sentiment.
Enmity supplies the relation's adverse starting state.
Love, support, and alliance supply the transformed relation.
Intimate kin-like nearness intensifies the endpoint from truce to warm proximity.

structural_cues: 41:34 follows the focus immediately and stages a before-and-after relation within one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the social reversal; I read it as a human-scale analogue of how gh-f-r and r-h-m operate together. A live alternative is that the verse prescribes human conduct without explicating the preceding divine qualities.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and mercy are dispositions possessed by the giver.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness and mercy are a relational operation that removes retaliatory force and converts estrangement toward intimate protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late human sequence oscillates between endless requests, collapsed hope under harm, possessive claims over tasted mercy, and withdrawal after blessing. The focus's guest-gift and min-source syntax resist that cycle: provision remains hospitality from a giver, not property generated by the recipient's claim.

activation_trace.role: Guest provision marks abundance as something prepared and offered by a host.
Beneficent tenderness locates the gift's source in the giver's disposition.
Persistent calling for good supplies the demand side of the unstable human cycle.
Cut-off hope supplies the abrupt collapse when desired good is interrupted.
Tasted beneficent tenderness is the gift that the recipient immediately treats as possession.
Bestowed good condition supplies the blessing after which the recipient withdraws.
Turning one's side away supplies the alienated response to received blessing.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeatedly alternates request, adversity, bestowed mercy or blessing, possessive confidence, and withdrawal.
The focus uses min to keep hospitality explicitly sourced in the giver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the late psychological cycle and the focus source grammar; I use the cycle to distinguish hosted gift from entitlement. The alternative is that the later passage critiques ingratitude without revising the semantics of nuzul.

changed_reading.before: The promised abundance is simply what the recipient is due.
changed_reading.after: The abundance remains a hosted gift: fully responsive to desire, yet received from forgiving mercy rather than possessed as self-authored entitlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers an ecological descent process into eschatological hospitality. It remains anchored by the same n-z-l delivery inventory in the focus and 41:39, reinforced by the explicit water-to-life sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not claim that the focus noun lexically means rain or resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The n-z-l noun can carry delivered descent as well as guest provision, while r-h-m permits beneficent life-giving care.

activation_trace.role: Delivered descent keeps the ecological analogy attached to the focus noun.
Beneficent tenderness supplies the life-serving direction of the descent.
Caused descent delivers the activating water onto the dormant earth.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the material provision.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life supplies the recipient's activated response.
Nourished growth supplies the sustained result of the delivered provision.
Earth's life through rain makes revival the explicit endpoint of the material sequence.

changed_reading.before: Hospitality is provision consumed by an already living guest.
changed_reading.after: Hospitality can be imagined as descending mercy that awakens and grows the guest, as water activates dormant earth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the womb branch of r-h-m and aligns it with fruit coverings and pregnancy in 41:47. It remains focus-anchored in the explicit r-h-m inventory and coheres with gh-f-r covering plus n-z-l guest preparation. Downstream prose should label it a gestational image of care, not an etymological definition of divine mercy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The r-h-m quality has a womb branch beside tenderness, and it modifies a prepared reception whose gh-f-r source also carries preserving cover.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected place of growth supplies the gestational image.
Preserving cover supplies the sheltering boundary around the cared-for recipient.
Provision prepared for a dependent arrival keeps the image tied to hospitality.
A plant vessel enclosing fruit supplies a parallel organic shelter.
Inward carrying of offspring or fruit supplies protected development.
Putting down a carried child at birth supplies emergence from protected development.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is tenderness added to an external gift.
changed_reading.after: Merciful hospitality can be imaged as gestational care: the guest is covered, carried, provisioned, and brought into a new condition.

strongest_changes: The matching descent-from-source formulas at 41:2, 41:32, and 41:42 turn hospitality into a divine delivery parallel in form to revelation.
The 41:30-32 sequence expands nuzul from goods into an angel-mediated reception protocol with reassurance, continuing care, and responsive provision.
The surah's opposed residences enlarge guest provision into secure homecoming, while its failed human covers sharpen gh-f-r as protection that does not obstruct access.
The post-focus enemy-to-intimate-ally reversal makes forgiveness and mercy an active transformation of relation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed a repeated source formula and linked the tiny focus coda to large descent, provisioning, enclosure, destination, and relational-reversal systems without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The three descent formulas may be stylistic source refrains rather than invitations to transfer revelation's delivery mechanism into hospitality.
Nuzul may name only served provision rather than the whole reception process or enduring counter-dwelling.
The cover reversal is coherent but may join distinct lexemes more tightly than the surah itself does.
The rain-revival and gestational readings should remain analogical outliers rather than lexical conclusions.
